name: mysql
description: MySQL and MariaDB: parameterised queries in read-only transactions, writes and DDL (nodes, or agents with an opt-in), tables, columns and query plans

nodes.title: Run a read-only query
nodes.description: Runs one parameterised SQL statement in a READ ONLY transaction that is always rolled back, so it cannot change data. Returns rows (objects), fields, row_count and truncated

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (?), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 500, at most 5000); `truncated` is true when more existed

statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default from the plugin's *_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000; agents can only lower it)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Run a write or DDL statement
nodes.description: Runs one parameterised INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL statement (autocommitted). Returns affected_rows, changed_rows and insert_id. Agents need MYSQL_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (?), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

max_rows.description: Most rows to return if the statement returns any (default 500, at most 5000)

statement_timeout_ms.description: The statement is killed (KILL QUERY) when it runs this long plus 5 s (default from MYSQL_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Explain a query plan
nodes.description: Shows MySQL's plan for one statement (EXPLAIN), in a read-only transaction. With analyze (MySQL 8.0.18+) it also runs the statement, still read-only

sql.description: One SQL statement. Put values in `params` and refer to them with placeholders; never paste values into the SQL

params.description: Values for the placeholders (?), in order: strings, numbers, booleans, null or JSON objects

format.description: Plan as table rows, MySQL's JSON plan or a text tree (ignored with analyze, which is always a tree)

analyze.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE: run the statement and report real timings (read-only, rolled back)

statement_timeout_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds (default from the plugin's *_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000; agents can only lower it)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List tables
nodes.description: Lists tables (and views) in a database with approximate row counts. Without `schema`, the connection's database, or every non-system database when there is none

schema.description: Database (schema) name. Default: the connection's database

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Describe a table
nodes.description: Columns (type, nullable, default, key, extra, comment), primary key, indexes and foreign keys of one table or view

schema.description: Database (schema) name. Default: the connection's database

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
